Subject: POC success metrics & trial plan — Blue Ridge next steps

Hi Elena / Amit — thanks again for a focused discovery today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations before kickoff.

Summary of scope
- Goal: Validate extractive QA + semantic search for customer support transcripts (English) at production throughput.
- Trial length: target 3 weeks (sandbox environment with monitored traffic).

Proposed success criteria (draft) — please comment:
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms for 1k-token request profile (measured end-to-end).
- Throughput: sustain 40–60 reqs/s for 1k-token prompts during peak 15-minute windows (burst tolerance to 100 reqs/s).
- Cost: average cost <= $0.0025 per 1k tokens served (we'll provide costed runbook).
- Quality: top-1 extractive answer accuracy >= 88% on your labelled eval set; hallucination rate < 4% (manual spot checks + automated false-positive signals).

Ownership & resources
- Blue Ridge: Elena (data validation / labels), Amit (infra contact for sample ingestion).
- Redwood: Ben (infrastructure & capacity), Priyom (SE — eval harness / instrumentation).

Immediate next steps
1) I attached our POC template (redwood-poc-template.xlsx) — please fill data volume and sample S3 path by EOD Thu 6/10.
2) We’ll prepare a mutual action plan (MAP) and a dedicated capacity estimate and share by Tue 6/9.
3) Proposed kickoff: Mon 6/14 — 30–45m technical kickoff (SE + infra + data owner).

Open questions for you
- Any constraints on data retention / masking we should know prior to ingest?
- Do you have a preferred SLAs/throughput windows we must mirror?

Attachments: redwood-poc-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to your quick confirmation so we can lock resources.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC success metrics & trial plan — Blue Ridge next steps

Thanks Vanessa — good capture. A few notes / tweaks from our side after internal sync: 

- Timeline: 3 weeks works. Proposed kickoff 6/14, acceptance checkpoint 6/25, closeout report 7/2.
- Latency: the p95 target is critical — we’d like p95 < 400ms if possible for 1k-token prompts (we realize tail depends on backend).
- Throughput: target steady-state 50 reqs/s; ability to handle 120 reqs/s bursts for short windows (we'll simulate spiky traffic).
- Cost: we need a run-rate estimate. Your target of $0.0025/1k tokens is reasonable — please include both hosted and Dedicated cost options.
- Quality: we can provide a 1,200-row labeled eval set for initial accuracy/recall checks. Also add embedding recall@10 >= 0.72 as an embedding-specific KPI.

Questions for Redwood: 
1) Can you confirm data retention and deletion controls for the sandbox? We handle PII but would prefer a 30-day retention in the trial environment with E2E deletion on teardown.
2) We need SOC2 type II evidence and a short architecture diagram (how KV cache / caching layer will be isolated).

If you can send the MAP and capacity estimate early next week, we’ll prioritize filling the POC template and getting the dataset ready.

—Elena
Head of Data Science, Blue Ridge Analytics
elena.morales@blueridge.ai | +1 617-555-0147

Elena / Amit — great, thanks for the clarifications. Finalizing the plan below — please reply with a short "confirm" by EOD Thu 6/10 if this matches your expectations.

Finalized acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Latency: p50 < 120ms; p95 < 400ms (1k-token request profile, end-to-end).
- Throughput: steady 50 reqs/s, spike capacity to 120 reqs/s for short windows.
- Cost: target <= $0.002 per 1k tokens on Dedicated; hosted estimate included for comparison.
- Quality: top-1 answer accuracy >= 88% on provided eval set (1,200 rows); embedding recall@10 >= 0.72; hallucination < 4%.
- Data controls: 30-day sandbox retention, documented deletion on teardown (we'll provide deletion checklist).

Timeline & owners
- 6/11: Redwood smoke test for p95 (Ben) — internal only.
- 6/11: Eval harness repo + initial metrics (Priyom).
- 6/14: Technical kickoff (Vanessa / Ben / Priyom + Elena / Amit).
- 6/25: Acceptance checkpoint and initial readout (metrics + qualitative notes).
- 7/2: Closeout + final recommendations.
